coverage.provinces: All seven metropolitan provinces listed on page 5.
coverage.dioceses: All 34 dioceses, including seven archdioceses, listed on pages 3 and 5.
coverage.deaneries: Only explicitly named deaneries in the accessible 2020 transcription; not a complete national list.
coverage.parishes: All explicitly listed parish entries in the accessible TEC 2020 transcription; deanery-linked where TEC provides an assignment, otherwise deanery_id is NULL pending verification.
notes: Historical 2020 baseline. Every new record requires verification before public API publication.
The publisher PDF URL returned HTTP 404 at retrieval; names and printed page references were transcribed from the publicly readable mirror.
Names use parish locations where a dedication is masked as [Link] in the accessible transcription. No missing dedication has been guessed.
Codes are application identifiers, not identifiers assigned by TEC. Parish codes do not contain deanery codes, so transfers preserve identity.
Outstations, congregations, chaplaincies, seminaries, technical and formation institutions are not seeded as parishes.
Parish-deanery assignments are not inferred from religious community addresses, geography, or a priest serving as a dean.
The Dar es Salaam section names ten deaneries on page 54, but does not provide a complete parish-deanery list. Its congregation tables are not parish lists.
